payout_quote: Compensation up to $18,050 or $32,450. Trial-related procedures at no cost. Transportation assistance. No insurance required. Qualifications (all must apply): males and females with overweight or obesity, diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, age 18+, BMI 25-45, light or non-smokers.
steps: Check that you meet all qualifications: diagnosed type 2 diabetes, overweight/obese (BMI 25-45), 18+, light or non-smoker (no more than 1 cigarette/day).
Apply on the Altasciences LA page and attend the screening visit; only qualified volunteers are enrolled (not everyone qualifies).

Complete one of the two schedules: e.g. screening + two 2-night stays + two 6-night stays + one 10-night stay + 8 outpatient visits, or screening + one 6-night + two 3-night + two 2-night stays + 5 outpatient visits — plus at-home doses and diary entries.
Compensation is paid for completing study milestones; study-related procedures are at no cost.
catches: You must pass the screening and meet strict qualifications (diagnosed type 2 diabetes, BMI 25-45, light/non-smoker); not everyone qualifies.
The compensation is an 'up to' ceiling (two schedule-dependent figures: $18,050 or $32,450) for completing the entire schedule; no floor is stated.
Massive time commitment: up to 22 nights of inpatient stays plus up to 8 outpatient visits, at-home doses, and diary entries — this is weeks of your life in Cypress, CA.
You receive an investigational treatment for type 2 diabetes/weight loss with real medical risks and side effects; only volunteers comfortable with clinical trial risk should apply.
The study is in-person at Altasciences LA in Cypress, California — useless unless you live nearby or can relocate for weeks.
biggest_catch: The payout is an 'up to' ceiling tied to completing a multi-week inpatient schedule in Cypress, CA — you must be diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, pass strict screening (not everyone qualifies), and accept real medical risks from an investigational treatment.
eligibility: Males and females with overweight or obesity, diagnosed type 2 diabetes, age 18+, BMI 25-45, light or non-smokers (max 1 cigarette/day). Must pass screening; must be able to stay in Cypress, CA for weeks of inpatient visits.
timing: Compensation is paid for completing study milestones/schedules; the route is weeks long (multiple inpatient stays plus outpatient visits).
